text:
Alex: Quick poll — where do you actually keep your home router? My neighbor upgraded to a mesh and my latency melted. Pics welcome.
Sam: Windowsill + plant. Signal looks great from my desk.
Priya: Pro tip: keep it off the floor and away from microwaves. Moved mine 2ft and latency dropped 80%.
Jordan: Microwave interference? For real? :thinking_face:
Priya: For 2.4GHz it's a thing. Also metal boxes/filing cabinets nearby = bad. Use a channel scanner app or `iwlist` if you're on Linux.
Mia: I built a little under-desk shelf for mine with velcro and a USB-C extension cable. Pics incoming 
Alex: Poll options: 1) On desk 2) Windowsill 3) Closet/cubby 4) Under-desk 5) Other — vote by replying the number
Sam: 2 — windowsill :house:
Priya: 4 here. Velcro + short extension cable = magic. :thumbsup:
Jordan: 3 🙈 closet. Latency spikes every evening, blame neighbors streaming.
Elena (infra-bot): FYI if you're using Redwood Dedicated from home for any testing, whitelist the VPN egress on your home firewall and make sure port forwarding isn't accidentally open. See internal doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/home-networking
Alex: Anyone tried powerline adapters? Thinking about them for the basement office.
Mia: Powerline adapters worked ok for me, but only when the house wiring is on the same circuit. Two floors + separate meter = nope.
Sam: Shoutout to @Priya — helped me pick a new AP last week, latency down ~30% :tada:
Alex: Nice! Also tiny experiment: I put the router in a cardboard box lined with foam to dampen noise and it... got worse. Not recommended. :sweat_smile:
Priya: Cardboard = muffles signal, haha.
Jordan: Vote tally so far: 2 x windowsill, 1 x under-desk, 1 x closet. Anyone else?
Mia: 1 — desk. I like aesthetics :nerd_face:
Alex: OK that's a wrap. Thanks for the tips — gonna try elevation + channel change tonight. Meme idea: "Router's true home: the windowsill fortress." :guardsman:
Sam: Post before/after pics if it helps others!
